description: React component for managing a customizable brand image in the admin console, including upload, display, and delete functionalities.

classes.name: BrandImageSetting
classes.description: React component class for brand image upload and management in admin console.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Fetches the current brand image on component mount and registers save action.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Unregisters the save action on component unmount.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates the image preview when a new image is selected.

methods.name: handleSelectClick
methods.description: Triggers file input click to select a new image.

methods.name: handleImageChange
methods.description: Handles image file selection and updates state.

methods.name: handleDeleteButtonPressed
methods.description: Marks the current image for deletion.

methods.name: handleSave
methods.description: Saves the new or deleted brand image via API calls.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI including image display, upload button, and error messages.
